# WRDW

> > WRDW News 12 is the local news source for Augusta, Georgia, delivering live newscasts, investigative journalism, and community coverage across multiple platforms.

WRDW is a Gray Television-owned news station serving the Augusta and Eastern Georgia region. The station operates News 12 and Augusta Weather 24/7 channels, along with investigative and community-focused programming.

## Key Topics

- WRDW News 12
- Augusta Weather 24/7
- Live streaming
- Local news

- [Live Newscasts](https://www.wrdw.com/livestream): Live streaming of WRDW News 12 and Augusta Weather 24/7 newscasts
